verdict.rationale: Lorikeet claims "conversational insights and analytics" from Coach and says Coach reviews 100% of tickets and turns findings into fixes. That implies some conversation-level analysis, but no evidence shows topic clustering or proactive detection of emerging product issues; the gaps Coach surfaces are about the AI agent's quality, not product trends. Missing for 10: explicit topic or theme clustering of conversations, emerging-issue or trend detection and alerting before volume spikes, product-issue reporting for support leaders, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
